title: mentha sylvestris var. serotina
intro: Mentha sylvestris var. serotina, commonly known as Woodland Peppermint or Late Peppermint, is a subspecies of mint plant characterized by its distinctive aroma and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Woodland Peppermint include relief from digestive issues, such as nausea and indigestion, due to its carminative and anti-inflammatory properties. Its therapeutic actions include soothing digestive problems, reducing inflammation, and providing a calming effect, making it a popular choice for natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of Woodland Peppermint include essential oils like menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
